description: Defines structures, classes, and functions related to User Equipment (UE) Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) context management, including PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) result handling, security configuration, and PDCP entity creation within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

classes.name: ue_srb_context
classes.description: Manages the security and PDCP context for a Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB) in a UE, including security configuration, reestablishment, and PDCP PDU packing/unpacking.

methods.name: enable_tx_security
methods.description: Configures transmission security parameters for the UE SRB.

methods.name: enable_rx_security
methods.description: Configures reception security parameters for the UE SRB.

methods.name: enable_full_security
methods.description: Enables full security (both integrity and ciphering) for the UE SRB.

methods.name: reestablish
methods.description: Reestablishes the security context for the UE SRB.

methods.name: pack_rrc_pdu
methods.description: Packages an RRC PDU into a PDCP PDU for transmission.

methods.name: unpack_pdcp_pdu
methods.description: Deciphers and verifies the integrity of a PDCP PDU.
